C1195.title: Luzhou Cyber Police Crack Down on SMS Bombing Software and Service Providers
C1195.summary: In 2024, while handling a relationship dispute case, Luzhou public security authorities faced retaliation when a suspect used an SMS bombing tool to harass the investigating officers. The Luzhou cyber police traced the attack and found that the suspect, surnamed Wang, had purchased a "call-you-to-death" service online, utilizing automated tools provided by a group led by a suspect surnamed Xie to

references.title: 'Harassment Calls' Rampant? Cyber Police Pursue from Afar!
